title: Living on a space station
examples: How do astronauts sleep when there is no gravity?
What do astronauts eat when they are in space?
Is it hard to exercise on the International Space Station?

explain.say: Today you will learn about life on a space station.
Astronauts use sleeping bags fixed to the wall. Then they stay in one place.
Astronauts eat food from sealed pouches. The food cannot float away.
Astronauts exercise every day in space. This keeps their muscles and bones strong.
Astronauts keep their things strapped down, so nothing floats away.
A common mistake is to think astronauts eat normal sandwiches. They use tortillas, because bread makes crumbs that float.

faq.q: Do astronauts sleep in their own beds?
faq.a: They sleep in special sleeping bags that are attached to the wall. This keeps them from drifting away while they rest.
asks: How do they sleep in space?
What do they use for sleeping?

faq.q: Is all the food in space in pouches?
faq.a: Many foods are in pouches or dehydrated to save space and prevent floating. Sometimes they eat special packaged items too.
asks: What kind of food do they eat?
Can they eat fresh apples in space?

faq.q: Do they have to exercise all the time?
faq.a: Yes, they must exercise regularly to keep their bones and muscles strong. This is very important for their health.
asks: Why do they exercise in space?

faq.q: What is the biggest challenge about living in space?
faq.a: One big challenge is floating. Everything, even water, can float away.
asks: What is it like floating in space?
What is the hardest part about space living?

faq.q: Can they just float while sleeping?
faq.a: They sleep in bags fixed to the wall. This stops them drifting and bumping into things.
asks: Is it safe to just float?
Do they need to anchor themselves?

facts: Astronauts use sleeping bags fixed to the wall.
Food is often dehydrated or in sealed pouches.
Exercise equipment helps them build muscle strength.
They must exercise daily to fight bone loss.

quiz.say: How do astronauts eat food in space?
quiz.why: Sealed pouches keep the food in, so it cannot float away.

wrong.1: Food on an open plate would float away.
wrong.2: Food in an open bag would float out.

quiz.say: What do astronauts do every day to keep strong?
quiz.why: Exercise keeps their muscles and bones strong in space.

wrong.0: Sleep helps, but muscles need exercise to stay strong.
wrong.2: Floating is easy, so muscles get weak without exercise.

options.show: in a bag fixed to the wall
options.say: in a bag fixed to the wall

quiz.why: A sleeping bag fixed to the wall keeps them in one place.

wrong.0: A normal bed would not hold them, so they would float off it.
wrong.1: Floating loose, they could drift and bump into things.
